title: Araki Art Archive
description: Interactive editorial archive documenting the intersection of Hirohiko Araki with haute-couture fashion, featuring a Swiss blueprint 12-column grid and kinetic GSAP motion.

caseStudy.tagline: Haute-couture editorial web archive exploring Hirohiko Araki’s intersection with high-fashion, classical sculpture, and Swiss architectural grid design.
caseStudy.system: Vue 3 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · GSAP · Lenis

problem.headline: Elevating manga narrative artistry into high-fashion architectural digital curation.
problem.description: Most anime and manga web exhibits resort to casual, cluttered fansite conventions. They fail to reflect that Hirohiko Araki is a world-class artist exhibited at the Musée du Louvre and an official collaborator of historic luxury houses like Gucci and Bulgari. The challenge was crafting an avant-garde digital lookbook inspired by European editorial benchmarks (such as mijobello.com) while preserving the signature dramatic tension and color fluidity of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure.

architecture.headline: Swiss 12-column architectural blueprint with kinetic GSAP timelines and zero-jank Lenis scrolling.
architecture.description: Engineered an editorial experience structured upon a persistent 12-column Swiss modernist grid overlay. Micro-interactions and typography are strictly aligned to coordinate boundaries, decoupling layout calculations from the viewport to guarantee 60 FPS motion even during complex height expansions and theme shifts.

highlights.title: Modular 12-Column Blueprint Grid
highlights.detail: Hardware-accelerated grid overlay dynamically adapting from a 4-column mobile matrix to a full 12-column architectural framework on desktop.

highlights.title: Dual Palette Chromatic State Machine
highlights.detail: Instant theme toggling between high-fashion "Runway Paper" (#f4ede2) and the psychological "Menacing Color Shift" (#170b1e violet & acid chartreuse) honoring Araki’s non-canonical color philosophy.

highlights.title: Kinetic Slot-Machine Micro-Interactions
highlights.detail: GSAP-powered vertical rolling text buttons, infinite live-timezone capital tickers (Paris, Milan, Tokyo), and dynamic silhouette hover displacement.

features.title: Curated Runway Capsules Slider
features.description: Interactive showcase documenting historic collaborations with Gucci (2011, 2013), Musée du Louvre (2009), and Bulgari (2017) with interactive silhouettes.

features.title: Fashion Capital Live Clock Marquee
features.description: Real-time multi-timezone clocks tracking international fashion capitals and exhibition landmarks with hover-pause physics.

features.title: Expanding Anatomy Accordion
features.description: Deep-dive analytical accordion deconstructing The Pose (contrapposto), Chromatic Fluidity, Rock & Roll Heritage, and Couture Tailoring.

takeaways: Strict architectural grid systems provide a timeless foundation that allows aggressive, avant-garde typography and motion to coexist harmoniously.
Decoupling layout transformations from native scroll events using Lenis and requestAnimationFrame is crucial for zero-jank editorial micro-interactions.
